<style>

body,
header#quarto-header,

  background: transparent !important;
}
#constellation-bg {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  pointer-events: none;
}
#quarto-header .navbar {
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
}
</style>

<script src="assets/vendor/tsparticles/3.9.1/tsparticles.slim.bundle.min.js"></script>
<script>
(async function () {
  // HOMEPAGE ANIMATION SETTINGS — edit these values, then run quarto render.
  // Counts are fixed budgets, not multiplied by screen area or pixel density.
  const SETTINGS = {
    speed: 0.18,                          // lower = slower drift
    colors: ['#FDD26E', '#FDD26E', '#87D7F2'],
    particleCount: 75,                    // desktop; keep below 100
    mobileParticleCount: 35,              // screens up to 760 CSS pixels wide
    particleSize: { min: 0.8, max: 1.8 },
    particleOpacity: { min: 0.25, max: 0.65 },
    linkColor: '#FDD26E',
    linkDistance: 150,                    // CSS pixels; larger = more connections
    linkOpacity: 0.18,
    fps: 30                              // 20–30 is enough for a background
  };

  const host = document.getElementById('constellation-bg');
  if (!host) return;
  // Escape Quarto's content column so the background covers the viewport.
  document.body.appendChild(host);
  const motion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  try {
    await loadSlim(tsParticles);
    const optionsForMotion = () => ({
        autoPlay: !motion.matches,
        fpsLimit: SETTINGS.fps,
        detectRetina: false,
        fullScreen: { enable: false },
        pauseOnBlur: true,
        pauseOnOutsideViewport: false,
        interactivity: {
          events: { onHover: { enable: false }, onClick: { enable: false } }
        },
        particles: {
          number: {
            value: SETTINGS.particleCount,
            density: { enable: false }
          },
          color: { value: SETTINGS.colors },
          shape: { type: 'circle' },
          size: { value: SETTINGS.particleSize },
          opacity: { value: SETTINGS.particleOpacity },
          links: {
            enable: true, color: SETTINGS.linkColor,
            distance: SETTINGS.linkDistance, opacity: SETTINGS.linkOpacity, width: 0.7
          },
          move: { enable: !motion.matches, speed: SETTINGS.speed, outModes: { default: 'bounce' } }
        },
        responsive: [{
          maxWidth: 760,
          options: { particles: { number: { value: SETTINGS.mobileParticleCount } } }
        }]
    });
    const field = await tsParticles.load({ id: 'constellation-bg', options: optionsForMotion() });
    if (!field) return;
    if (motion.matches) field.draw(true);
    let pending = Promise.resolve();
    motion.addEventListener('change', () => {
      field.pause();
      // v3 refresh rebuilds from source options; reset replaces that source.
      pending = pending.then(async () => {
        await field.reset(optionsForMotion());
        if (motion.matches) { field.pause(); field.draw(true); }
      });
      return pending;
    });
  } catch (error) {
    // The base CSS background remains usable if canvas or the library fails.
    console.warn('Constellation unavailable; using static background.', error);
  }
})();
</script>

::: {.message style="max-width: 1100px; margin: 60px auto 0; line-height: 1.6;"}

::: {.text-center}

#### Designing adaptive robotic hardware that help robots work reliably in the messy real world.
:::

::: {style="text-align: justify; margin-top: 30px;"}
My goal is to enhance the capabilities of robots by building hardware that overcomes existing physical limitations. By integrating compliant mechanisms, designing torsion-resistant metamaterials, and embedding flexible tactile sensors. When the hardware is smart, adaptive, and structurally resilient, the software boundary expands.
:::
